q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are semantically equivalent. Both queries retrieve email addresses from the PERSON table that appear more than once. In Q1, COUNT(EMAIL) > 1 counts the number of occurrences of each email, and in Q2, COUNT(*) >= 2 counts the total number of rows per email group. Since each group consists of rows with the same email, both conditions yield the same result.
